results.content: * Evaluate your organization’s AI risks. ## The Risks of AI. AI governance is a set of policies, processes, and best practices that help organizations ensure that AI systems are developed, used, and managed in a responsible and scalable way to maximize benefits and mitigate risks. ## Evaluate AI Risks. Now that Coral Cloud has its AI inventory, the team can start assessing the organization’s risks from AI. Here’s how Alex and the AI leadership team evaluate the organization's AI risks. Now that Coral Cloud’s AI committee has completed their assessment, they’re ready to implement some strategies to help mitigate all those risks. | Operational | * Risk assessments * Incident response plans * Change management * Documentation and company-wide education * Metrics and monitoring * Internal ethics reviews for new AI products and features |. Alex and the rest of Coral Cloud’s AI leadership team know that it’s impossible to avoid all AI-related risks.

results.title: Cloud-based CMMS software for facilities management
results.content: Experience how Corrigo transforms facility maintenance through work order automation, comprehensive asset management and sophisticated business intelligence. ### What are best practices for Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) software implementation? Yes, Corrigo is available as a cloud-hosted SaaS platform, enabling centralized work order orchestration, vendor management and near real-time reporting across multiple sites. Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) software focuses on work order management, preventative maintenance scheduling and technician workflows. Corrigo serves core CMMS needs with enterprise integrations to EAM and CAFM systems for holistic asset strategies. Corrigo automates work order routing, enforces SLAs, manages third-party vendors and aggregates performance data for analytics. ### What does the Corrigo CMMS do? Corrigo automates the work order lifecycle, orchestrates vendor and contractor workflows, reconciles contractor invoicing, supports mobile technician workflows and integrates with CAFM/ERP systems to centralize maintenance operations and measure maintenance ROI. If your goals include managing work orders, assets, and service providers, starting with a CMMS is a logical choice.
